submission.natural_language_explanation: Retrospective boundary-marker head: it fires when the current token closes a sentence- or clause-initial constituent (a comma terminating an initial name, greeting, temporal or date expression, adverbial clause, or appositive/list item) or opens the following noun phrase (the determiner the/a after a short introductory word). It stays weak when the same comma position holds a non-boundary word or the determiner is replaced by a non-determiner.
